definitions.explanation: To go into a place, often one that is not easily accessible or where one is not supposed to be.
To enter secretly or without permission.
To become immersed in something (figurative use).

notes:
{入|はい}り{込|こ}む is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to enter or get into.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to enter) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (deeply into) → to go deep into

ASPECT (ている):
{入|はい}り{込|こ}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of being inside or immersed.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|はい}り{込|こ}む (get into a room)
- ⟦{隙間|すきま}→隙間：00389_sukima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|はい}り{込|こ}む (get into a gap)
- ⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|はい}り{込|こ}む (get immersed in a world)
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入|はい}り{込|こ}む (get into a conversation/story)

USAGE:
Implies going deeper or more thoroughly than simple ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧. Often suggests entering somewhere one shouldn't be, or becoming deeply involved in something.
